sections.content:
6,695 people

were counted on the census as "dispensing opticians" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Dispensing opticians supply, fit and service spectacles, contact lenses and other optical aids in accordance with a prescription from an optician or optometrist.

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "dispensing opticians" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "dispensing opticians", 14.6% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "dispensing opticians" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.title: The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years
sections.footer: Source: Census 2021 from Office for National Statistics

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "dispensing opticians" included:

  • restaurant and catering establishment managers and proprietors
  • management consultants and business analysts
  • medical and dental technicians

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "dispensing opticians" there were more women than men (69.9% compared with 30.1%).

This means "dispensing opticians" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "health and social care associate professionals".

Men made up 30.1% and women made up 69.9% of "dispensing opticians"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "dispensing opticians" included:

  • housing officers
  • coffee shop workers
  • human resources and industrial relations officers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "dispensing opticians" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged 50 years and older, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "dispensing opticians" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "dispensing opticians", 9% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (65.6% compared with 34.4%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (89.2%) than self-employed (10.8%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Bradford, this is in the region of the Yorkshire & Humberside.
